MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The hook-and-loop strips fit the practical fastening needs behind my tape purchases, while letting me secure equipment and remove it later.",
    "The heat-shrink tubing complements my earlier electrical terminals by helping insulate and tidy connections instead of simply giving me more connectors."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The locking nuts, half-inch washers, and drywall anchors require particular fastening or mounting jobs that I have not shown a need for.",
    "The temperature controller, digital caliper, and electronic cleaner assume specific projects or maintenance needs that my repair-supply purchases do not establish.",
    "The 1,080-piece connector kit and twelve tubes of super glue feel excessive without a substantial wiring job or a specific glue repair."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of clamps, tape, and terminals seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when its purpose differs.",
    "My previous assortment purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to offer more large packs, although usefulness depends on what the pieces would help me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A useful next purchase should support a recognizable task, such as insulating terminal connections or securing loose equipment.",
    "The exact material, size, and purpose matter: vinyl cement does not establish a need for general-purpose super glue, and hose clamps do not establish a need for half-inch washers.",
    "My purchases are spread over several years, so an older electrical-supply purchase is only a clue, not evidence that I have a large wiring project underway."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical repair supplies but too often assumed specific projects and quantities beyond what my history supports."
}
